title: user login with valid credentials
description: Test the user login API by submitting valid email and password credentials and verify that the user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the customer home page.

title: user login with invalid password
description: Test the user login API by submitting a valid email with an incorrect password and verify that the authentication fails and an appropriate error message is displayed.

title: user registration with valid details and otp
description: Test the user registration API by submitting valid name, email, and password, then provide the correct OTP to verify successful account creation and prompt to login.

title: user registration with invalid email or mismatched passwords
description: Test the user registration API by submitting invalid email formats or mismatched passwords and verify that validation errors are shown preventing registration.

title: user registration with incorrect otp
description: Test the user registration API by submitting valid registration details but providing an incorrect OTP and verify that OTP verification fails with an appropriate error message.

title: customer home browse featured products
description: Test the customer home API by loading the home page, browsing featured products, using search and filters, adding items to the cart, and verifying the cart updates accordingly.

title: customer home search unavailable item
description: Test the customer home API by searching for an item that does not exist and verify that a no results found message is displayed.
